shown.message:
`paper-repo`'s rebuild request (`figtab-repo`#5) was already done in `b6dbcb3`, so I replied and closed it. I checked the medians `paper-repo` expected against `floor_b_by_background.csv`, and they reproduce. Over the 19 cells that have all four backgrounds, the medians are:

| Background | Median top-3 agreement |
|---|---|
| B20 | 0.463 |
| B50 | 0.609 |
| B200 | 0.742 |
| k-means50 | 0.822 |

Those 19-cell medians aren't plotted in any figure. In Fig 5 the B=50 floor covers 20 cells, with a median of 0.596. I sent `paper-repo` the Fig 5 caption ranges as well.

`figtab-repo`#4 stays open. German MLP floor b by B hasn't been delivered, and I'll rebuild when it lands.
